thread:
Alex B.: Following up from today's postmortem — consolidating remediation owners and short timelines for the recurring cache/eviction incidents. I'll drop items; please claim or flag if dates look off.

Priya S.: Thanks Alex. Will link a parent ticket after owners are set.

Alex B.: Item 1: Add eviction telemetry + deploy-aware alerting. Jira: INFR-8120. Suggested owner: storage infra. Due: 7 days.

Marco H.: Taking INFR-8120. Plan: eviction-rate metric, Grafana panel, and an alert that ignores deploy window tags. Target 2025-04-03.

Alex B.: Add acceptance criteria in the ticket: (1) dashboard, (2) alert rule with deploy filter, (3) runbook link.

Marco H.: Will update INFR-8120 with criteria and a short verification plan.

Alex B.: Item 2: Throttle & jitter for background cleanup jobs to avoid synchronized spikes. Jira: INFR-8121. Due: 2 weeks.

Zoe L.: I'll own INFR-8121. Implementation: introduce `throttle_pct`, per-region jitter, and a feature-flagged rollout.

Priya S.: I'll update RUN-120 with a short checklist and include the immediate mitigation commands.

Alex B.: Item 3: Safety rollback hook for config changes based on latency/eviction SLOs. Jira: PM-900. Need RACI here.

Zoe L.: Proposed RACI: Zoe (R), Alex (A), Marco (C), Priya (I). I'll implement the hook wiring and add unit tests.

Priya S.: RUN-120 checklist snippet (will paste into ticket):

```
- Check eviction dashboard
- If eviction rate >5% for 10m: `jobsctl throttle --group=cleanup --pct=50`
- If tail latency >2s for 5m: trigger config rollback: `cfgctl rollback --change-id $ID`
- Escalate to platform oncall if still degraded after 15m
```

Marco H.: For verification I'll prepare a small load-spec: 2x write QPS for 15m to reproduce evictions. Will attach to INFR-8120.

Alex B.: Ops-bot, set a follow-up reminder for one week from now 10:00 UTC.

ops-bot: Reminder set: Postmortem follow-up 1 2025-04-03 10:00 UTC.

Priya S.: Also creating parent INFR-8200 to track cross-cutting mitigations and long-term mitigations. Link child tickets when ready.

Marco H.: Linked INFR-8120 -> INFR-8200.

Zoe L.: Linked INFR-8121 and PM-900.

Alex B.: Quick process note: each ticket must have owner, due date, PR link, and verification steps. If you can't meet the due date, mark it blocked with a short reason.

Priya S.: I'll run a runbook walkthrough with platform oncall two days before the follow-up.

Marco H.: One more ask: please document expected false-positive scenarios (deploy spikes) in the alert description to reduce noise.

Zoe L.: Will do. Thanks everyone — ping here if you reassign tickets. :thumbsup:
